metadata.scoringScale: Each axis is scored from 0 to 10. Total is relevance plus specificity plus intent fit plus coverage ability.
metadata.collisionPolicy: Reject exact, containing, or contained slugs; title or H1 token overlap above 60 percent after stopword removal; exact primary keyword ownership; same-searcher intent; and candidate-to-candidate cannibalization.
metadata.sourcePolicy: Use official framework, standards-body, platform, project, and first-party engineering documentation over secondary summaries.
